name: Shinozaki panri
source:
University freshman. Former vocalist and leader of the band.

Tall and flashy, he stood out noticeably during his time in the group.

Naturally kind and well-liked,he's always in a relationship.

Gets along well with former band members. Has a subtly carefree and unpredictable side.
